messages:
nina: quick note — proposing temporary pin of sdk v3.2 for eu canary after observed model binding errors during the nightly rollout. tagging this to ops for ACK.

oscar: which errors specifically? any stack traces or sample logs?

nina: error seen: "ModelLoadError: incompatible kernel" in 6/300 requests around 2024-06-03T02:04Z. no elevated 5xx for customers yet, but model instances failing to initialize and fallback kicking in.

deploybot: deploybot: pin request received: sdk v3.2 -> requires release lead approval and ops ack before enforcing pin.

release-coordinator: noted. suggest pin window 2h for observation and diff against sdk v3.1. I'll add a release note stub: "EU canary pinned to sdk v3.2 pending investigation".

sre-eu: ops-ack. propose rollback gates: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR model-load-failures >3 in a 10m window -> rollback to sdk v3.1 and route to fallback runtime.

nina: agreed. quick operational checklist I'm adding here:
- set canary throttle to 15%
- enable fallback routing to runtime:v2.13
- enable model-load failure alert (count >3 /10m)
- monitor p99 and 5xx for 30m initial window
- rollback command: `deploybot rollback sdk v3.1 --cohort eu-canary --reason "model-bind failures"`

oscar: running smoke now, will post logs in ~8m. if I see >2 load failures during smoke I will trigger rollback.

release-coordinator: approving pin for observation. tagging #general with a brief note if we roll forward or back within the window.

deploybot: deploybot: Action queued: enforce pin sdk v3.2 on eu-canary. Observ window: 7200s. Awaiting enforcement approval.

nina: enforcement approved. please proceed and keep this thread as the single source of truth for decisions.

oscar: smoke complete: 1 load failure in 100 requests, p99 steady. holding.
